sex.Description: Self-reported sex/gender field as represented in the source demographic data.

group.Description: Randomized breathing intervention group, harmonized from source condition codes.

Levels.slow_paced_breathing: Slow-paced/resonance-frequency breathing (source codes RF or F).
Levels.random_paced_breathing: Random-paced breathing (source codes RP or P).

study_status.Description: Participant progression status derived from inclusion in the 60-person demographics file and the randomized condition field in the merged analysis file.

Levels.post_randomization_dropout: Randomized but did not complete the allocated intervention.

dropout.Description: Whether the participant dropped out before or after randomization, derived from study_status.

race.Description: Self-reported race from the source demographic data.

ethnicity.Description: Self-reported ethnicity from the source demographic data.

physical_activity.Description: Physical activity response code retained from the source data.

height_inches.Description: Height in total inches; calculated from feet and inches when needed.

retired.Description: Whether the participant reported being retired.

weekly_alcoholic_drinks.Description: Reported number of alcoholic drinks per week.

ever_smoked.Description: Whether the participant reported ever smoking.
